token_set.name: Hometown History: Detroit Red Wings
token_set.description: Introducing Hometown History: Detroit Red Wings, a compilation of highlights commemorating historical moments celebrated by the Red Wings during the 2024-25 season. These collectibles not only honor the rich history of the team but also rewind the clock to capture the players and achievements that solidify the franchise in the hearts of fans, and within the pages of NHL history.

description:
Steve Yzerman, the Detroit Red Wings' captain for an unparalleled 22 seasons, was an unstoppable force on the ice. He reached the 50-goal mark in five different seasons, amassing an incredible 692 career goals. During the 1992-93 season, Yzerman notched his 50th goal in a game against Edmonton with a play that showcased his skill and elusiveness. Receiving a pass in full stride, Yzerman streaked down the ice, deftly maneuvered around a defenseman, and fired a shot five-hole to cap off the milestone in style.
